name: byrodi
description: Plugin marketplace and catalog of byrodi's agent skills for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: github-publish
plugins.description: Checks a project for leaked secrets, adds the missing repository files and publishes it on GitHub.

plugins.name: project-docs
plugins.description: English project documentation in docs/ that coding agents read first and humans understand at a glance, kept in sync with the code as the agent works.

plugins.name: minimal-code-discipline
plugins.description: Keeps code changes small by reusing what exists and preferring the standard library over new dependencies.

plugins.name: java-code-style
plugins.description: Java code style for new and personal projects, based on Google Java Style with a Checkstyle config and design conventions.

plugins.name: typescript-code-style
plugins.description: TypeScript and JavaScript style based on Google TypeScript Style, with strict tsconfig, typescript-eslint and Prettier configs.

plugins.name: rust-code-style
plugins.description: Rust code style for new and personal projects, based on the official Rust Style Guide, Clippy workspace lints and the Rust API Guidelines.

plugins.name: chrome-devtools
plugins.description: Agent skill that drives a real Chrome through chrome-devtools-mcp when WebFetch cannot read a page.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Light pink-plum design system for sites, web apps and desktop UI, with CSS tokens and an interactive HTML starter.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Agent skill that removes signs of AI writing, bureaucratic phrasing and filler from Russian and English text.
